## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] No secrets in the diff or commit history (API keys, passwords, cookies, `config.json`, `*.db`, `steam-2fa.json`)
- [ ] No new network destinations, or they are documented in the README "Privacy" section
- [ ] Logs do not print login names (use `maskLogin`), passwords, tokens or authenticator data
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated if behavior changed
